notes.title: Update "Legendary Oldschool Music"
notes.content:
1 We finally add the Tracker (chiptune editor)
 - Now you can create your own music in old style 8bits console.

Bug fixed:

1 crash when leaving empty game.
2 Text editor invisible icon
3 lose focus when close some window

New feature:

1 Damage tile.

OBS.: all game created will go empty with the new update, if you dont want to lose your games created:

- Go to the "golden8bits" directory:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Golden8bits\img

- copy the file "game 2.json" and "game21.json" for the second card game, "game3.json" and "game31.json" and so on. This files are inside "img" directory. 

- Then update steam golden8bits and replace after the update with your old files.
